name: Gordon
title: Gordon — Trading Agent
description: AI trading agent for crypto and equities. Connects to 10 native exchanges (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Bitfinex, Hyperliquid, OKX, Gemini, Uniswap, Robinhood, Binance US) plus 100+ exchanges via CCXT. Built-in risk classifier, evidence bundle, trade ledger, and the Gordon safety stack. Runs proactive radar for news/regime/volatility/funding signals.

auth.description: Set provider keys in env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, or DEDALUS_API_KEY. Optional exchange credentials (BINANCE_API_KEY etc.) for live trading.
